Business strategy & research

Business strategy
& research.

Make the next business decision with better information.

Discuss your project ↗

Based in Poole, Dorset. Working remotely across the UK and internationally.

An idea can sound convincing before anyone has checked the demand, competition, costs or practical work involved. I help small businesses investigate the questions that matter, turn the findings into a workable direction and decide what to do next.

WHEN YOU NEED A CLEARER PICTURE

Business advice grounded in the work.

You might be considering a new service, trying to understand a competitor, preparing a business plan or investigating why something is not working. The starting point is the decision you need to make, rather than a standard report with your name added.

I bring more than 20 years of experience across business operations, ecommerce, marketing and digital projects. That helps me look at how an idea would work in practice: who will buy it, what it needs to cost, how it will be delivered and what could get in the way.

Some projects need a focused piece of research. Others need a broader commercial plan or practical help putting the findings to use. We agree the questions, scope and deliverables before the work begins.

What I can help with

  • Competitor and market research
  • Customer and audience research
  • Testing a business idea or assumption
  • Business and commercial planning
  • Reviewing processes and operational problems
  • Turning research into an action plan

What you get from the research.

The deliverable should help you make a decision. Depending on the brief, that might be a competitor comparison, a commercial plan, a set of prioritised recommendations or an assessment of the options and their practical implications.

I distinguish what the evidence shows from what remains an assumption. Where useful, I include the sources and explain any gaps or limitations. Research can reduce uncertainty; it cannot promise that a product will sell or that a business will succeed.

From findings to delivery

If the next step involves a website, ecommerce work or clearer positioning, those can be scoped as separate pieces of work. You can also take the findings away and implement them yourself.

RELEVANT WORK

Strategy with practical deliverables.

For Little Leaps Sports CIC, the work connected sponsorship strategy with campaign materials and personalised outreach. The case study explains the decisions behind the materials and what was delivered.

Before we start.

Do I need a finished business plan before contacting you?

No. Start with the decision, problem or idea you want to explore. Tell me what you already know, what you have tried and when you need to act.

Can I book a small research project?

Yes. Focused research starts from £150. The quote sets out the questions, deliverables and scope; a wider business plan is a separate piece of work.

Do you only work with businesses in Dorset?

No. I am based in Poole, Dorset, and work remotely with clients across the UK and internationally. Availability and deadlines are agreed for each project.
